verdict.rationale: Notion's own marketing claims agents that 'keep work moving 24/7' (notion-docs-8), and the Agent API docs confirm first-party Custom Agents whose status, usage and credit limits can be managed (notion-docs-22, notion-docs-29), which points to autonomous background agents as a native capability. The evidence is thin, though: there is no documentation of how users configure triggers, schedules or unattended runs. The REST API and webhooks are only developer building blocks, so they earn no credit. Missing for 10: documented trigger/schedule configuration for background automations, details of how Custom Agents run unattended, and independent or hands-on corroboration that they run autonomously in practice.
